pages.text:
## Meet Mark Takano
After more than 20 years as a classroom teacher, in 2012 Mark Takano was elected to represent Riverside, Moreno Valley, Perris and Jurupa Valley in the United States Congress. In Congress, Mark works to advance local priorities: creating good-paying jobs, keeping local families in their homes, improving public education, and honoring the service of our veterans. He will never stop fighting to protect Medicare and Social Security, and strengthen America’s middle class.
## On the Issues
Improving Our Economy
In Congress, Mark Takano works every day to bring good-paying jobs to the Inland Empire.
Mark Takano will always stand up for America‘s veterans, to ensure that they receive the benefits they have earned.
A public school teacher for more than 20 years, Mark Takano is leading the charge in Congress for better schools.
Join Mark’s grassroots team and our movement to bring real change to the Inland Empire.
Your support today will help Mark keep fighting for our region's priorities in Congress.

## Meet Mark .
For more than thirty years, Mark Takano has worked to improve the lives of Riverside County residents as a high school teacher, a college trustee, and now as a Member of Congress.
Born and raised in Riverside, Mark's commitment to public service began at an early age. His family roots in Riverside go back to his grandparents who, along with his parents, were removed from their respective homes and sent to Japanese American Internment camps during World War II. After the war, these two families settled in Riverside County to rebuild their lives…[ READ MORE ]
Mark proudly represents California's 39th district located in the heart of the Inland Empire. Support his re-election today!
For the latest from the campaign trail, follow us on social media.
